title: Lectric eBikes hits $1 billion in sales, surpasses 750,000 e-bikes
summary: The largest electric bicycle company in the US, Lectric eBikes, has just hit a pair of dizzying milestones. The much-vaunted e-bike maker reached $1 billion in sales on its e-commerce platform yesterday and sold its 750,000th electric bicycle. And perhaps even more stunning, it landed those two feats on the same day.

title: This all-electric VinFast taxi service just debuted in Europe
summary: Vietnamese all-electric taxi operator Green SM has made its European debut in Copenhagen, rolling out a company-owned fleet of VinFast EVs.

title: Podcast: Tesla/SpaceX merger, Rivian R2 progress, new Mercedes GLA, and more
summary: In the Electrek Podcast, we discuss the most popular news in the world of sustainable transport and energy. In this week’s episode, we discuss rumors of a Tesla/SpaceX merger, Rivian’s earnings, R2 progress, and efficiency test, new Mercedes GLA, and more.

title: BYD reveals images of the new Qin Max EV ahead of its launch next month
summary: The Qin Max is a “completely different new B-segment fast-charging sedan,” BYD claims. Ahead of its official launch next month, BYD released new images, offering a look at it inside and out.

title: This huge Texas solar hub is nearly 1 GW, and it’s only half built
summary: Renewable energy developer Origis Energy has brought another 500 megawatts (MWdc) of solar online at its Rockhound complex in West Texas, pushing the sprawling project’s operating capacity to nearly 1 gigawatt (GW).

title: Hyundai reveals new 7-seat electric minivan concept
summary: Hyundai unveiled the new Neira Concept, a seven-seat electric minivan, at GIIAS 2026.

title: BYD undercuts Defender with its first 7-seat SUV in the UK
summary: BYD is bringing its boxy, seven-seat SUV to Europe and the UK. The Ti 7 is now on sale in the UK, and it’s even cheaper than the Land Rover Defender PHEV.

title: NHTSA probes 1.2M Tesla Model 3, Model Y over suspension failures
summary:
The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an investigation into roughly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles after receiving 156 complaints of a front suspension component detaching while driving.

The probe covers 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2021-2023 Model Y vehicles, and it centers on the front lower lateral link separating from the car.

title: HMP’s new $3,999 electric scooter is the affordable, street-legal commuter the US needs
summary:
The US electric two-wheeler market has no shortage of high-powered electric motorcycles and moped-style e-bikes. But if you’re looking for something in between – a practical, street-legal electric scooter built for everyday transportation rather than weekend thrills – your options are surprisingly limited.

That’s why the new HMP Lightning MK.II caught my attention.

title: Hyundai IONIQ 5 spotted with a new high-tech setup and large 18″ digital screen
summary: A mysterious IONIQ 5 test mule was caught in South Korea with an all-new interior setup, including a large 18″ infotainment screen.

title: Anyland Rev Pro e-motos have this one weird trick…auto wheelies!
summary: We’ve seen quite a few low-cost mini e-Moto pit bikes that flirt with the $1000 price tag over the past months, but today’s has a really interesting trick: It auto-wheelies. It can’t be that simple can it? I grabbed my 14-year-old and some extra padding to find out.

title: Wheel-E Podcast: VW e-bikes, Juiced Scrambler, Anyland Auto-wheelie, more
summary: This week on Electrek’s Wheel-E podcast, we discuss the most popular news stories from the world of electric bikes and other nontraditional electric vehicles. This time, that includes new e-bikes from VW and Specialized, a Huffy kids’ e-bike, Veo adds a three-wheeler to its shared micromobility lineup, we tested the new Juiced Scrambler, Anyland Rev Pro HMP launches 75 mph Flash e-scooter, and more.

title: Tesla weighs selling China business to clear path for SpaceX merger
summary:
Tesla is looking at cutting loose its China business to clear a path toward a merger with SpaceX, according to a new Wall Street Journal report.

If true, it would be a massive deal in the auto industry. Tesla’s Shanghai factory builds more than half of all Tesla vehicles, so any separation would carve out the single biggest piece of Tesla’s car operation.

Update: Elon Musk has denied the WSJ report, but as usual, that should be taken with a grain of salt.

title: The PJM grid’s largest battery is now under construction in Ohio
summary: A giant 1 GWh battery is now under construction outside Columbus, Ohio, where data center and industrial development is rapidly pushing up electricity demand.

title: Juiced Scrambler: Testing the best bang-for-your-buck moto-style e-bike
summary:
Juiced Bikes is one of the most recognizable names in the history of electric bikes in North America. Long before e-bike classes and speed limits became commonplace, the company built a loyal following with powerful bikes that blurred the line between bicycles and mopeds. But after the brand collapsed in 2024, many assumed Juiced was destined to become little more than a nostalgic footnote.

Now it’s back under new ownership, and after spending several days riding the new Juiced Scrambler alongside Juiced’s fearless new leader Austin Gomes, I came away thinking the company is now going beyond trying to recapture the past. Instead, it’s trying to redefine what a legal, street-ready moped-style e-bike can be.

title: A new Zipcar pilot pairs shared EVs with off-grid solar charging
summary: Four Greater Boston communities now have off-grid solar EV chargers powering a new Zipcar pilot designed to bring affordable carsharing to places that have historically gone without it.

title: The Kia EV3 will go on sale soon, with production set to begin in Mexico next week
summary: Kia opened pre-orders for the EV3 in Mexico, where the electric SUV will be built and shipped to the US later this year.

title: Rivian (RIVN) Q2 2026 earnings: revenue up 27%, gross margins soaring
summary:
Rivian reported its second-quarter 2026 earnings today, and there are improvements across the board. It’s a car. The company started delivering the R2, its first vehicle priced under $50,000, to customers on June 9.

The financials came in strong too. Revenue reached $1.658 billion, up 27% year-over-year, and Rivian posted a record $179 million gross profit while beating Wall Street on revenue, earnings, and adjusted EBITDA.

title: Tesla’s Elon Musk is having a generational meltdown
summary:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk has spent 2026 turning his X feed into a problem no investor relations team can fix. His posts have escalated from trolling into open white nationalism, and this week his AI company sued the state of Minnesota to block a law targeting nonconsensual sexual deepfakes.

The board of a public company would have fired the CEO for just a fraction of the stuff Musk is posting these days. However, Tesla is not a normal company. Shareholders have given full control to Musk and now, they have to live with it.

title: BMW opens i3 orders months early as buyers rush in
summary: The new i3 is here sooner than expected. Although it wasn’t expected to go on sale until this fall, BMW has already opened orders in several markets after “high levels” of early interest.

title: The Genesis GV60 Magma costs $10,000 more than the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N
summary: The GV60 Magma will begin arriving at dealerships soon. Priced $10,000 higher than the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N, is it worth upgrading to the Genesis?

title: BYD’s electric kei car gets off to a strong start with over 5,000 orders in its first week
summary: BYD’s electric kei car has already secured over 5,000 orders, more than half of its target by the end of 2026 in just one week.

title: China is starting to measure EV charging times in seconds, not minutes
summary:
One of China’s newest EVs is also its fastest-charging, with the ability to fill its battery from 10-70% in 4 minutes and 22 seconds.

But that’s not the only recent announcement of a fast-charging battery that quotes how many seconds it takes to fill up, showing that the race for fast charging has entered a new era which treats seconds as the significant figure, rather than minutes.

title: Tesla hits 10 million vehicles — but its EV growth has stalled
summary:
Tesla has built its 10 millionth vehicle, the company announced this week. Ten million all-electric cars is a real milestone, and no other automaker has done it.

But it’s arriving later than Tesla once promised, and the company is now building well under the capacity it already has.

title: Plug-in port: Brazilian Port of Santos electrifies DP World terminal
summary: DP World is electrifying its port fleet at the Brazilian Port of Santos with 15 battery-electric terminal trucks and three electric reach stackers in a move that marks another key step toward clean freight handling at one of Latin America’s busiest container ports.

title: IEA: Global EV sales jump 35% in Q2 and 50 countries set records
summary: Global EV sales shook off a rough start to 2026 and came bounding back in Q2, jumping 35% from the first three months of the year and setting quarterly records in 50 countries.

title: Trump feds use a solar review to approve the first AI data center on public land
summary: Apparently, a 19-megawatt (MW) solar farm and a 167-MW AI data center are “substantially the same” – at least according to the Trump administration’s Bureau of Land Management (BLM).

title: The new Mercedes GLA EV is bigger, smarter, and has a range of over 400 miles
summary: Mercedes-Benz gave its smallest SUV a glow-up. The new electric GLA offers more space for passengers, ultra-fast charging, and a range of over 400 miles.
